text: Thank you for that initial assessment; the fatigue-related worsening of symptoms is a crucial clue. To further narrow the differential between myasthenia gravis and Lambert-Eaton myasthenic syndrome, have you noticed any dry mouth, difficulty swallowing, or urinary retention accompanying your weakness? speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The presence of elevated acetylcholine receptor antibodies confirms the diagnosis, especially given your symptoms of fatigue-worsening double vision, limb weakness, and difficulty climbing stairs.
